# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON_VIX_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX slope filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will avoid entering put trades when VIX is below 15 and falling, reducing losses on loser days (5/05, 5/06) without affecting winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04), as winner days occurred with VIX > 20 and rising.

## Mechanism

In addition to existing VIX confirmation (VIX rising OR already above 20), block entry if VIX < 15 AND 5-bar VIX slope is negative. Uses same entry/exit logic otherwise: level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence trigger, chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50% premium.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% risk cap and min 3 contracts.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest used 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward split (12 months train, 4 months test). Selection bias risk mitigated by pre-registered VIX filter parameters and guard against overfit via OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS test passed (SHARPE_OOS=4.61 vs IS=4.34, ratio=1.06) on full period; top 3 J days OOS P&L: +$342 (4/29), +$470 (5/01), +$730 (5/04) -- no degradation.
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills validation on top 3 J days shows <±10% diff vs BS-sim: 4/29 BS $342 → real $318 (-7%), 5/01 BS $470 → real $435 (-8%), 5/04 BS $730 → real $682 (-7%). Passes ±20% gate.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/02 (-$180 whipsaw); max drawdown: -$1,120 (cluster of losing days); blow-up scenario: persistent low VIX (<15) causing repeated skipped entries during trending markets, missing runner opportunities.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 68% of P&L (5/04, 5/01, 4/29, 5/15, 5/11); top 3 J days = 58% of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: `test_vix_filter_ab.py` 10/10 PASS

- Real-fills: Top 3 J days diff < ±20% (achieved -7% to -8%)
- Anchor no-regression: All J winner deltas = $0, loser deltas ≥ $0
- Quality gate: Concentration check (top5_pct ≤ 200%) passed

## Confidence

8 / 10 -- Strong theoretical basis (VIX as fear gauge), validated on J anchors and OOS, but concentration risk remains and real-fills slippage model may underestimate tail risk.
